Azeroth Survivors Mind Blast Priest build

Last updated: November 11, 2026

Field guide

What is Azeroth Survivors?How to playBuildsTier listDownload & fixesSafety checkTalent treeLuck

Apo’s Disc–Shadow setup keeps a small upgrade pool around Mind Blast, Shadow Word: Pain and Power Word: Shield. The shared tree spends 30 points in Discipline and 21 in Shadow and assumes all eight Field Marshal PvP pieces at +5. If you are still leveling or collecting gear, use the class guide for a starting setup.

Fill the slots before spending banishes

The six choices are Mind Blast, Shadow Word: Pain, Power Word: Shield, Devouring Plague, Psychic Scream and Mind Flay. The last three can leave the upgrade pool. Apo removes Plague early and gives Scream and Flay some cooldown and area first. Keep a banish available if the current draft has an extra Pain target or a strong Mind Blast or Shield offer you want to take.

Decide which problem the next card should solve

Run problemWhat to check
The next pack outlives your opening attacksCheck Mind Blast targets and damage first. An extra target helps most when several enemies are available.
The boss arrives while your damage is still weakApo generally gives an early legendary Mind Blast offer priority.
Incoming damage is forcing you away from packsCompare the Shield offer with your current survival needs. The author makes room for a strong Shield card when damage is already on pace.

Check gear separately from talents

Apo uses a cooldown ring alongside either critical chance or defensive jewelry. If you try the Endless tab, review its jewelry before copying the spell choices. Compare attempts at the same difficulty and with the same set pieces so you can tell whether a card change helped.
